fusions.name: Paper Cut
fusions.desc: A quick slash that deals 5 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Flying Edges
fusions.desc: Looses 3 knives in a spread, each of which deals 25 damage. Every hit is a critical hit, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Slip Into Shadow
fusions.desc: Veils you for 9 seconds, and you move 28% faster while veiled. Enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Taste of Blood
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
